blueprint.label: Refinery
blueprint.description:
Taken from
https://factorioprints.com/view/-LX0DrUrauJqH8cVAq6A
with minor changes:
- self-starting coal liquifaction without bots
- increased light oil cracking to keep up
- increased methane flow

Suggest building around an oil field in the open area, pumped into the station at multiple points.  Let trains make up the difference.

entities.name: arithmetic-combinator
entities.player_description: Code the train request according to the train-length.  The output is routed through the train-stop so that it can't go out until the train-stop exists.
